review_type: primary-assistant AI engineering review; not human, independent or blind gold
stage: P0 engineering and AI review plus P1 offline development; no tested-model runtime
pool: all legal previously observed old evidence, including unmodeled tool observations; no path eligibility

retrieval.algorithm: deterministic BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75 plus current-state features
retrieval.query: original issue + last3 actual actions; no annotation label features

coverage_constraint: G2-G4 first retain latest unsuccessful actual test for each exact selector not superseded by a later successful same-selector run; informative only for its own version
coverage_infeasible: preserve original references, report unmet constraints and best effort; never silently claim coverage
graph_expansion: G3 only sourced exact entity/evidence/definition relations, G4 additionally Inferred static resolutions; no invented runtime resolution
stable_revision: repo + known base_commit + exact private workspace version; no fabricated post-edit commit
partial_code: Reference when qualified name/signature cannot be established from complete visible text; exact same-version character slices may be joined

review_scope.open_world: unmodeled visible tool feedback inventory plus source inspection, not proof no other omissions exist

quality_reference: old AI labels remain frozen for regression only; new pool items unlabelled, precision bounds reported
holdout: 12 task IDs, >=6 repositories, disjoint from v175 selected points + v181 + v193; historical benchmark exposure disclosed; no holdout payload or scores opened
cost: local token estimates and CPU only; no API ledger spend
